publicUrl.title: Server public URL
publicUrl.description: Address devices outside the browser use to reach this server. Sonos speakers fetch the stream from it. Left empty, the server uses its own address on the speaker network.
publicUrl.loopbackWarning: This address means "this machine" to whatever reads it: no device outside the browser can reach the server. Use its network address.

listenAddr.title: Listen address
listenAddr.description: Interface and port the server accepts connections on. `127.0.0.1` keeps it to this machine; `0.0.0.0` opens it to the network, which devices fetching the stream need.

chromecast.discoveryHelp: Chromecasts are discovered automatically on your local network. Discovery is multicast, which does not cross a router: a server in a Docker container on a “bridge” network, which is routed despite the name, will see nothing. A Chromecast Ultra can also take ethernet through its power supply.
